test_title: PYST 23: SSC MTS 2024 - General Awareness (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following is the correct statement about the Rajya Sabha?

options.text: All the members are directly elected by the people.
It is known as the Council of the States.
It is known as the lower house of the parliament.
The term of the members is for 5 years.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It is known as the Council of the States**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Rajya Sabha is also known as the Council of States, representing the states and union territories of India.
 
• Members of the Rajya Sabha are elected by the elected members of State Legislative Assemblies and by the members of the Electoral college for Union Territories, using a single transferable vote.
 
• The Rajya Sabha is a permanent body and is not subject to dissolution; however, one-third of its members retire every two years.
 
• The Vice President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Term of Members:** Each member of the Rajya Sabha serves a term of six years, with one-third of the members retiring every two years.
 
• **Composition:** The Rajya Sabha can have a maximum of 250 members, out of which 12 are nominated by the President of India for their contributions to art, literature, science, and social services.
 
• **Role and Powers:** The Rajya Sabha has legislative powers, but it cannot initiate or amend money bills. However, it can suggest amendments to money bills, which the Lok Sabha may or may not accept.
 
• **Sessions:** The Rajya Sabha meets in continuous sessions, and unlike the Lok Sabha, it is not subject to dissolution.
 
• **Special Powers:** The Rajya Sabha can authorize the Parliament to legislate on a subject from the State List if it is deemed to be of national importance, by passing a resolution with a two-thirds majority.
